chat.sp.jack.intro:
Happy Halloween!
I am Jack, the Czar of Halloween!
Tonight is a very special, spooky night...
Let's make it frightfully fun!
chat.sp.jack.ask:
Now then... trick or treat!
No candy, and you'll get a trick!
chat.sp.jack.thanks:
Ooh! Candy!
The sweetest joy of Halloween! Thank you!
chat.sp.jack.trick:
What... nothing at all?
Then it's a trick! Heh heh heh...!
chat.sp.jack.0: The sweetness of candy is tonight's magic...
chat.sp.jack.1: Dressing up as a ghost is half the fun of Halloween!
chat.sp.jack.2: The pumpkin lanterns are glowing just right.
chat.sp.kk-slider.0: Hey. Up for a song tonight?
chat.sp.kk-slider.2: Turn the music on and I'll play you one.
chat.sp.kk-slider.3: Saturday nights, you'll find me here.
chat.sp.daisy-mae.2: I only come on Sunday mornings!
chat.sp.daisy-mae.3: Good morning! What a nice day!
chat.sp.wisp.1: The island's so quiet at night…
chat.sp.gulliver.1: I seem to have fallen off my ship…
chat.sp.gulliver.3: My crew should come get me soon!
zukan.title: Critterpedia
zukan.hint: Catch, dig up or pick things up on the island to fill this in!
zukan.hintPresent: Pick up balloon presents to fill this in!
chat.sp.kk-slider.intro:
Hey, I'm K.K.
Saturday nights, I play here.
Turn the music on
and I'll play you one, anytime.
chat.sp.daisy-mae.intro:
Morning! I'm Daisy Mae!
I sell Grandma's turnips.
Just saying hi today…
See you next Sunday morning!
chat.sp.wisp.intro:
Boo! …Did I scare you?
I'm Wisp. I'm a ghost.
Please don't be scared…
I just love night walks.
chat.sp.reese.intro:
Hello! I'm Reese.
This is my husband, Cyrus.
We came to cheer you on
for your wedding!
chat.sp.reese.day:
Congratulations on your wedding!
Have a wonderful day!
chat.sp.reese.0:
How are the wedding
plans coming along?
chat.sp.reese.1:
Your two smiles are
just lovely.
chat.sp.reese.2:
Staying healthy every day is
the best gift of all!
chat.sp.reese.3:
We're looking forward
to the big day too!
chat.sp.cyrus.1:
I was nervous on
my wedding day too.
chat.sp.cyrus.2:
Seeing Reese this happy
makes my day.
chat.sp.cyrus.3:
Take care of each other,
you hear?
chat.sp.franklin.intro:
Happy Turkey Day!
I'm Franklin, the chef.
Today's the day we all sit down
to a big feast together!
chat.sp.franklin.ask:
For my very best dish
I need one fish.
If you catch one, would you
bring it to me?
chat.sp.franklin.thanks:
Oh! A splendid {fish}!
Thank you! Now I can make
the finest feast of all!
chat.sp.franklin.0:
Smells good, doesn't it?
Almost ready!
chat.sp.franklin.1:
Food in season
gives you energy!
chat.sp.franklin.2:
Your fish is going to
taste wonderful!
chat.sp.jingle.intro:
Merry Toy Day!
I'm Jingle!
Tonight's the special night
I deliver presents!
chat.sp.jingle.1:
It's cold out, so stay
warm when you sleep!
chat.sp.jingle.3:
Ho ho! Have a
jolly Toy Day!
chat.sp.pave.intro:
Welcome to Festivale!
I'm Pavé!
Today we dance
the whole day long!
chat.sp.pave.0:
Come on, step it up!
One, two!
chat.sp.pave.2:
Dancing warms the heart
and the body!
chat.sp.zipper.intro:
Hoppy hop!
I'm Zipper!
Let's hunt for
Bunny Day eggs!
chat.sp.zipper.0:
Eggs hide in the ground
and on balloons, hop!
chat.sp.zipper.1:
You might even fish
one up, hop!
chat.sp.zipper.3:
Hop hop! Let's keep
bouncing along!
chat.sp.celeste.intro:
Oh, good evening!
I'm Celeste. I just love the stars.
There'll be lots of shooting stars tonight!
Let's watch them together.
chat.sp.celeste.0:
When you see a shooting star,
tap the sky and make a wish!
chat.sp.celeste.1:
Wish on one, and tomorrow morning
star fragments wash up on the beach.
chat.sp.celeste.2:
This season's sign is {sign}.
You might find its fragment too!
chat.sp.celeste.3:
Hoo! Did you see that one?
What a lovely shooting star!
chat.sp.gulliver.intro:
…Mmmh… Huh!
What island is this?
I seem to have fallen off my ship…
I'll wait here for my crew.
chat.sp.kk-slider.hello:
Hey, thanks for coming out tonight.
Got a request?
chat.sp.kk-slider.tuning:
Just tuning my guitar right now…
Give me a little while.
museum.label: Museum: open the Critterpedia
museum.day.0: Hoo... wha? Oh! Welcome to the museum!
museum.day.1: Hoo... *yawn*... Daytime is no time for an owl, I'm afraid.
museum.day.2: ...Zzz... Hm? Hoo! Oh, hello there! Do come in.
museum.night.0: Hoo! Welcome! The museum is at its finest by night!
museum.night.1: Hoo hoo! Come to browse the Critterpedia tonight?
museum.night.2: Hoo! I'm positively wide awake at this hour!
museum.night.find: Hoo! I hear you found {name} recently!
world.door.rs.0:
Oh, {name}! Hello!
You can change the sound and language settings right here.
world.door.rs.1:
Let's make today a great day!
Is there a setting you'd like to change?
world.door.rs.2:
Welcome to Resident Services!
If you're ever unsure how things work, just ask.
world.door.nook.0:
Ah, {name}! Yes, yes, working late, are we?
The settings are right here.
world.door.nook.1:
Hm, the island is lovely at night, yes?
Is there something you'd like to change?
world.door.cranny.2:
Your rewards are right this way!
"...this way!"
world.door.able.0:
Hiya! Welcome to Able Sisters!
Who would you like to be today?
world.door.able.1:
Oh, {name}! You look lovely today!
You can change your look and nickname right here.
world.door.able.2:
Hee hee, my sister's hard at work in the back!
Go ahead and pick!
world.door.airport.0:
Hey hey hey! Welcome to Dodo Airlines!
Want to check on the connection?
world.door.airport.1:
Thanks for stopping by!
Your messages are coming through loud and clear!
world.door.airport.2:
Your gateway to the skies, Dodo Airlines!
I'll take you to the comms station.
world.door.campsite:
The campsite.
Nobody seems to be here right now.
world.door.campsite.guest:
The campsite.
{name} is visiting the island today.
world.wilbur:
Wilbur here! {name}'s on the island right now.
Take it easy. Over!
